title: Observability deploy script and host self-check (dry run and stubs)
proves: deploy-observability.sh in DESK_DEPLOY_DRYRUN=1 shows every step, copies every traefik template by glob, drops the REVOKE line, forces OBS_METRICS_PORT=0, stops naming a missing or malformed webhook file, never posts a test alert and never prints the webhook URLs; stack-selfcheck.sh passes against healthy stubs, fails each check separately, and --notify posts once per hour per failing check without the URL in arguments or output.
doesNotProve: Anything on the real host: ssh, DNS, docker, Postgres role creation, Traefik, the systemd install, or delivery to real Google Chat. The deploy script has never been run against production.
